input_contract: Implement struct d_ecs with4 entity IDs, component masks1(position),2(velocity),3(both), and2 rows per archetype. Set creates, replaces or migrates an entity; step updates only the both-component table. Build a query adapter for required/excluded masks and a structural version counter for cached table selection. Specify deletion/reuse as a separate generation-bearing extension, never silently reuse an ID while old views survive. All structural edits happen outside an active iteration borrow.
expected: Create entity0/1 in mask1 and entity2 in mask3. Moving0 into mask3 succeeds and moves1 to row0 of mask1. Moving1 into now-full mask3 rejects without deleting it. Step changes both-component positions30,10 with velocities2,1 into32,11; a later overflow preserves the whole table.
independent_oracle: Enumerate all legal entity/mask requests for bounded traces up to length6, compare masks and active values with a dictionary oracle and check both mapping directions after every step. Explicitly test self-migration, last-row removal, destination full and overflow at each visited row. For cache tests, distinguish a changed set of matching tables from changed rows within an existing table. Benchmark equal query results with a scalar dictionary and include structural edits in the workload.
